why: ψίθυρος (whisper) is not a near-synonym of rustle
'με ακούραστη διάθεση' is not a natural combination
αλέτρι is not of the same root

gloss: (colloquial) to slag off, slam, mock; (of crows) to caw, croak; (old) to cry out, call

example.el: Τον έκραξαν όλοι για τη δήλωσή του.
example.en: Everyone slammed him for his statement.

collocations.en: they slagged him off on Twitter

why: slang 'slag off' is today's dominant sense; dropped rare 'κράζω από μακριά'; synonyms aligned with main sense
ξινός means sour, not astringent; fixed English of στυφό φρούτο
μούσμουλο usually denotes the loquat, not the medlar
'η Πύλη των Λεόντων' does not contain the lemma
ελιά is not an opposite
ερημίτης (hermit) is not a near-synonym
μολύνω (pollute/infect) is not a near-synonym
σβήνω is not a true opposite of 'set on fire'
main modern sense is 'much-talked-about' (often ironic); 'notorious' is closer to διαβόητος
επαναστατώ is not a true opposite

gloss: to be best man/sponsor at a wedding; (passive) to get married; to crown, garland

collocations.en: I am best man/matron of honour at a couple's wedding

why: wedding sense is the everyday one; dropped rare 'στεφανώνω το μνημείο' (usual: καταθέτω στεφάνι)
τεχνητός (artificial) is not a near-synonym
English 'shock' mistranslated κρίση
συνειδητός/ασυνείδητος are not synonym/opposite of 'self-aware'
μαντινάδα is a kind of couplet, not a synonym

gloss: (of a rooster or bird) to crow, sing; (Cypriot, Cretan) to say, tell; to speak
why: in standard Greek the bird/rooster sense is the common one; say-sense is dialectal
Ελληνοκύπριος is a compound, not a collocation; Ελλαδίτης is not an opposite
dropped invented 'σιγά μη σου ρίξω και μούντζα'; added the common κάνω μούντζα
καταριέμαι/αναθεματίζω/ευλογώ fit only the secondary sense
example uses the 'wife' sense missing from gloss; 'φέμενα του σπιτιού' doubtful
'γεροντική γκιόσα' is not a natural combination
αστυφύλακας (city police officer) is a different force, not a synonym
